text: This is a demo, and it's fifteen and a half gigabytes.
It's Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World. Befriend monsters, raise them, and fuse two into something new.
The full game lands in December. The demo lets you start the adventure now.
It's in nine languages, with online co-op and PvP already listed.
Worth a dip, if you've got fifteen gigabytes spare.
That's Demo Dip. A new Steam demo, every day.
